building_market_mix.value: Single-family homes for retail homebuyers, primarily entry-level and first move-up, sold in communities across several U.S. states

project_building_type.value: Residential communities of new single-family homes, built to order with personalized floor plans, homesites and design options

contract_pricing_risk.value: Fixed-price home sales contracts with individual buyers, with options and upgrades priced by buyer selection; builder bears construction cost risk

self_perform_subcontract_scope.value: Construction largely subcontracted to trades; company manages with superintendents, using supplier-partner building products

builder_contractor_role.value: Land-owning operative homebuilder building and selling homes on its own account, with affiliated mortgage financing

land_inventory_exposure_operative_builde.value: Owned and optioned land held for communities, plus built-to-order homes under construction and some speculative homes
